sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Fire Isolation with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Confuse and Despair Resistance Up by 50

[Bouquet for You] Kanade or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
